images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 28 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light ivory plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 72 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: oversized black aviator sunglasses and a chunky ivory wool scarf at the top, a long camel wool single-breasted coat (below-knee length) folded neatly, a plain white crew-neck cotton t-shirt, straight-leg mid-blue full-length jeans, and a pair of red satin low-heel pumps at the bottom. RIGHT HALF: a full-body street style photo of a young Korean woman wearing exactly the same items - the camel long coat worn open over the white t-shirt, the ivory wool scarf wrapped around the neck, mid-blue straight jeans covering the ankles, red satin low-heel pumps, sunglasses held in one hand - walking through a bright airport departure hall with large windows, only in the lower 72 percent. Headless body-only framing: the figure is cut at the collarbone, NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible at all. Identical items in both halves, realistic fabric textures, soft winter morning daylight, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no signs, no brand marks.
